name: Agama'gor
summary: North of the road from Camp Taurajo toward Mulgore, Agama'gor presses against the Horde outpost. Bristleback quilboar hold the encampment in the southern Barrens.

sections.title: A Bristleback Stronghold
sections.body: Agama'gor’s huts, brambles, and crude totems lie close to Camp Taurajo. Bristleback quilboar hold the stronghold, threatening travelers between the Barrens and Mulgore’s grassy hills. Horde scouts and hunters fight to contain them.

sections.title: Blood Shards and Exile
sections.body: Crimson stones called Blood Shards are carried by the Bristlebacks in Agama'gor. Mangletooth, an exiled quilboar held captive at Camp Taurajo, seeks them through ancient beliefs about Agamaggan’s sacred essence. Horde adventurers raid the encampment for shards, then trade them to Mangletooth for tribal charms.

faq.answer: Agama'gor’s large Bristleback settlement lies in the southern Barrens, directly north of the road west from Camp Taurajo toward Mulgore.

faq.q: Why are the Bristleback quilboar here so hostile?
faq.answer: Quilboar believe all land touched by the fallen Ancient boar god Agamaggan belongs to them. The Bristlebacks see the nearby tauren and orcs of Camp Taurajo as invaders on their ancestral soil.

faq.q: What can you find in Agama'gor?
faq.answer: Bristleback quilboar in Agama'gor carry Blood Shards, crystallized deposits of primal power. You can trade them to Mangletooth, an exiled quilboar in Camp Taurajo.

faq.q: Who is Mangletooth and how does he relate to this place?
faq.answer: Mangletooth is an exiled quilboar held in a cage at Camp Taurajo. He resents his kin and offers Horde adventurers protective charms for Blood Shards taken from the Bristlebacks of Agama'gor.

angles.text: As Horde defenders pass through Camp Taurajo, keeping Agama'gor's Bristlebacks in check helps protect the outpost. Their warriors remain a priority.
As a tauren, you face danger from Agama'gor's marauders along the path to the Great Gate and Mulgore. They threaten supply lines and pilgrims.
